messages.subject: Re: HTTP 500: Child Task 118644 error when updating Shinyapps.io app with deployApp()
parts:
After about 24 hours of trying at random intervals, it seems to now be updating all new deployment changes.



Application successfully deployed to http://fernando.shinyapps.io/ggplot2test

So don't be discouraged if you get:

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 118644 error: Unhandled Exception: HTTP 500: Internal Server Error

It may take up to 24 hours but it should work eventually! :)
